CASTING CALL: Musical Theatre Performers for a staged reading in Manchester.

Creatives House (https://www.creativeshouse.org.uk/) is looking to cast 3 male and 1 female performers for a staged reading of a new, original musical that is currently being developed under our Artist Incubator with ACE funding.

Please see the attached image for further details. Applications and enquiries can be sent to hello@creativeshouse.org.uk. Please do not DM me. Thank you!

items.text:
Hi all me again ☺️

I am looking for the opportunity to work on some unique and exciting projects. I am an actress based within the West Midlands fairly local to Birmingham and easy connections via train to London or further up north. I have a valid DBS and I am open to working on Student films, Short, Films along with feature films or mini series anything really that gives me the opportunity to act as I don’t yet have a showreel but I am SPOTLIGHT listed. 

I am very drawn to horror especially paranormal and folklore and period stuff. I also love dramas, action and mysteries. 

Some of my favourite movies and shows are

Hemlock Grove - series 
IT Movie Welcome to Derry - series
Stranger Things - Series
Doctor Who - Series
The Conjuring  (Universe)- Movie
The Crow - Movie
John Wick - Movie
Saw - Movie
Final Destination 3 - Movie

I have on SET experience as I have worked on two big Bollywood movies with some of India’s famous actors but I have also worked on two smaller SETs. I have experience working inside and outside including doing a water shoot which involved getting soaked with water. I’m also willing to be a stand in or a body double.

I would love to also get into scare acting over the Halloween period 🙂

If you feel you have something that you feel would suit me I would love to hear from you. 

Many thanks ☺️

**WARSZAWA**

**6 i 9 września**

**Stawki od 120 zł -220 zł gotówką**

**Serial fabularny KB**

** **

Na plan serialu fabularnego szukam statystów**:**

** **

**6 WRZEŚNIA (niedziela):**

**- MĘŻCZYZNA W TYPIE TIROWCA – **myje ręce w toalecie. 1 scena na 5:50. Stawka **150 zł gotówką**

**- KLIENCI STACJI BEZNZYNOWEJ Z AUTEM – **wiek bez znaczenia. Bez białych aut.** **Stawka** 180 zł gotówką. **Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

**- POLICJANCI MUNDUROWI **– mężczyźni 20-50 lat. Stawka **130 zł gotówką**

**- KLIENCI SKLEPU OSIEDLOWEGO – **kobiety i mężczyźni, wiek bez znaczenia.** **Stawka** 120 zł gotówką**

 

**9 WRZEŚNIA (środa):**

- **WOLONTARIUSZE FUNDACJI** – młodzi ludzie 18-35 lat, chętnie alternatywni. Stawka** 120 zł gotówką**

- **ROBOTNICY / PRACOWNICY WARSZTATU** – mężczyźni 18-60 lat. Stawka** 120 zł gotówką**

- **STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI** – stawka** 170 zł gotówką**.  Bez białych aut . Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

**- PRZECHODNIE –** **plan nocny do ok. 1:00 w nocy.  **Stawka** 180 zł gotówką**

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI - plan nocny do ok. 1:00 w nocy.  **Stawka **220 zł gotówką**. Bez białych aut. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB 6** lub** KB 9**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

CASTING CALL: MOM, 40s
Axis is casting a woman in her 40s for a short, cinematic Advent video filming in Centennial, Colorado.

The character is a relatable, overwhelmed mom trying to keep up with the chaos of Christmas. We are looking for an actor with strong comedic instincts who can also bring warmth, subtlety, and emotional honesty to the role.
Filming date: September 17
Time: 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
Location: Centennial, Colorado
Pay: $500
To submit, please email the following to [Irene@axis.org](mailto:Irene@axis.org) by September 9:

- Self-tape using the attached audition side
- Current headshot
- Acting resume
- Reel, if available
Please use the subject line: “Advent Light Audition – [Your Name]”
Include your phone number and confirmation that you are available for the full filming window. This role includes both on-camera performance and voiceover.

items.text:
**Title**: **IS THAT YOU, GOD?**

**Genre**: *Horror*

**Logline**: When young Anastasia confides in God ... He speaks back. Though, she soon realizes there is no escape from the restrictions of religion.

Roles:

**ANASTASIA** - *LEAD* - *Female, 8-15*

Quiet, but curious. Naive and sweet. She's always trying to find comfort within the religion her mother forces upon her.

**MOTHER** - *SUPPORTING* - *Female, 40-60*

Strict and snappy. An incredibly catholic woman who *will* make her daughter a follower as well.

**"GOD"** - *SUPPORTING - Male, 30-55*

A voice that Anastasia believes to be the one, true God speaking back to her. Determined, he will stop at nothing to get Anastasia. 

**FATHER MICHAEL** - *SUPPORTING - Male, 40+*

A kind and professional priest, trying to help Anastasia take the correct first steps in her faith.

**Director**: Lizzie Kleewein

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**: 

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

THIS WEEKEND

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 1pm-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "IS THAT YOU, GOD? - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will provide sides to send in a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 23-26th, and 28th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to religious trauma.

The club is Drama & Games for little ones aged around 6–7 years old, so someone who is energetic, enthusiastic and great with children would be perfect! 😊

📅 Every Wednesday
⏰ 3:00–4:30pm (teaching time is approximately 3:15/3:30–4:10pm)
📍 Cockfosters, Barnet EN4
🎭 Drama & Games – ages 6/7

Must have a valid DBS and be reliable.

If this sounds like something you’d be interested in, please PM me for more information.

Thank you! 💛

**WARSZAWA**

**16 / 18 / 22 września**

**Serial fabularny KB**

** **

Na plan serialu fabularnego KB szukam statystów na dni poniżej. Tym razem przenosimy się na przejście graniczne z Ukrainą. Magia kina – gramy w Warszawie.

** **

**16 WRZEŚNIA (środa):**

Tutaj czwartek 17.09 jest rezerwą. Gdyby była zmiana na 17.09, będę pytać o dostępność smsem. Gramy parking na przejściu granicznym. Plan w Centrum Targowo-Kongresowym EXPO.

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI -  **szukam różnych aut na parking z wyłączeniem białych. Stawka **180 zł gotówką**. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

- **PODRÓŻNI / PASAŻEROWIE AUTOKARU** -  kobiety i mężczyźni w różnym wieku. Stawka **130 zł gotówką**.

 

**18 WRZEŚNIA (piątek) i 22 WRZEŚNIA (wtorek):**

Fabryka dronów, zaplecze wojenne. Plan na terenie FSO, na Jagiellońskiej.

- **MUNDUROWI I CYWILE **– kobiety i mężczyźni do 55 lat.

Stawka **130 zł gotówką – **osoby na 1 z tych dni.

Stawka  **170 zł gotówką** – **osoby kontynuacyjne na 2 dni**, wskazane przez reżysera. Łącznie **340 zł za 2 dni **płatne 22 września gotówką.

** **

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB 16** i/lub** KB 18** i**/**lub** KB 22 lub KB KONT**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

sharedPost.text:
ATELIERS THÉÂTRE - ADULTES

Quand ?
Tous les samedis matins de 10h à 12h

Où ?
Au TNR, 3-5 rue Péan, 75013 Paris // Métro : Porte d’Ivry (Ligne 7)

Combien ?
180€ par trimestre + 10€ d’adhésion.
Il est possible d’avoir un tarif préférentiel selon votre coefficient familial (égal ou inférieur au QF4).

Le cours d’essai est gratuit !

Inscriptions, contactez Andréa : 06 32 07 69 48 // andrea.fulconis2@gmail.com

DESCRIPTIF

Le cours est ouvert à tous les adultes de 18 à 99 ans, désireux de rencontrer - ou de re-rencontrer - le théâtre.

- L’année sera divisée en deux parties - 

De septembre à décembre, nous travaillerons les outils du comédien par le biais d’exercices et d’improvisations (seul, à plusieurs, ou en collectif). Nous aborderons le corps et la voix de l’acteur, mais aussi son rapport à l’espace, à l’autre, au public, au silence... À travers cette recherche préliminaire, nous souderons le groupe. Le collectif sera notre maître-mot : c’est ensemble que l’on apprendra et que l’on grandira au plateau. L’objectif étant de monter une pièce ensemble durant la deuxième partie de l’année.

De janvier à juin, nous monterons, en effet, un spectacle à partir d’un texte d’auteur. Classique ou contemporain, comique ou tragique, nous trouverons l’auteur qui vous fait envie, la langue que vous voulez porter, l’histoire que vous voulez défendre ! Nous entamerons, alors, un travail précis d’interprétation du texte et de personnages, à travers une mise en scène crée sur mesure pour votre groupe. Un langage commun et une esthétique propre à la création nous rassemblera.

Plusieurs représentations sont prévues à la fin de l’année : nous jouerons notre pièce plusieurs fois devant un public bienveillant !

LA PROF - Andréa Fulconis

En parallèle d’un Master de Littérature Française à La Sorbonne, Andréa se forme aux Conservatoires d’Art Dramatique (CRD de Cannes, CRR de Nice et CRD de Bobigny). Puis, elle intègre l’École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, célèbre école de jeu corporel. Enfin, elle intègre la LUDI (Ligue Universitaire d’improvisation d’Île-de-France) et se perfectionne en improvisation.

Elle travaille, par la suite, pour plusieurs compagnies d’île-de-France en tant que comédienne, improvisatrice et metteuse en scène, comme Tonnerre de Singe, La Mazane ou Les Loups-Graou, qui sont tout autant d’espaces et des foyers de création lui permettant de développer sa recherche artistique.

La pédagogie prend également une place importante dans sa vie puisqu’elle est professeure de théâtre et d’improvisation pour la Cie Maya, la Ludo Impro’, La Mazane, et désormais au TNR, pour la Compagnie Tonnerre de Singe

Riche de toutes ces expériences, Andréa mêle, dans ses cours de théâtre, un travail précis de texte - hérité de sa formation classique - à une recherche vivante et corporelle, telle qu’elle s’en est emparée par la suite dans son travail artistique. Ses cours sont, pour elle, un espace de recherche à part entière, au même titre qu’une création professionnelle.

At Our Core - Casting Call

sharedPost.text:
🔥 FABRICAMOS BÁSCULAS PROFESIONALES PARA ACTOS ACROBÁTICOS DE ALTO IMPACTO

No todas las básculas sirven para realizar el mismo trabajo. Según las características del acto, la altura de los lanzamientos, el número de acróbatas y las exigencias técnicas, se requiere un tipo específico de báscula.

Por eso, antes de fabricar, evaluamos las necesidades del artista y ofrecemos orientación profesional basada en la experiencia directa de Wilfredo Mauricio Triana Villalón: maestro, fabricante y usuario de aparatos circenses durante más de 30 años.

Fabricamos:

• Báscula: caballete y machimbre
• Mesa de salto
• Percheras
• Perchas
• Zancos dobles y de un solo apoyo
• Sillón
• Colchonetas de protección

Cada aparato y complemento se fabrica y cotiza por separado, de acuerdo con las necesidades específicas del acto.

Un gran acto necesita una gran herramienta.
No fabricamos juguetes: fabricamos herramientas de trabajo para profesionales.

📲 Información, asesoría y pedidos: +51 994 195 258
🎪 Mundo Circense SXE

items.text:
Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

🤝 Collaboration: Artist collaboration / project-based
✨ Looking for: Male & Female artists/actors with a natural screen presence

If you’re interested in being part of the project, please DM me with a few photos/videos and a short introduction.

Let’s create something beautiful together. ❤️

items.text:
Missed out on the Edinburgh Fringe this year? Or already desperate for another go? Then we have an opportunity for you!

We’re Such People Productions, a theatre company founded by poet and playwright Nadia Lines in 2024. 

We’re headed to Edinburgh Fringe in the summer of 2027 with our show The Book of Margery Kempe, and we need a producer to help make it happen!

In this fast-paced, time travelling retelling of the autobiography of one of the
Middle Age’s most incredible women, real-life medieval mystic Margery Kempe takes to the stage to give us her life in her own words – tears and all.

For fans of y2k medievalism, women’s history, and sacrilege, The Book of Margery Kempe is already a sold-out, five star, award-winning production. You can find out all about the play, and our company, below - or find us on Instagram @suchpeople.productions 

All of the information you need to apply to be our producer is the google doc linked in this post. Or, if you're looking for a more low commitment way of getting involved, then you can sign up to be a Friend of Margery.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 

https://linktr.ee/thebookofmargerykempe

items.text:
**WARSZAWA**

**16 / 18 / 22 września**

**Serial fabularny KB**

** **

Na plan serialu fabularnego KB szukam statystów na dni poniżej. Tym razem przenosimy się na przejście graniczne z Ukrainą. Magia kina – gramy w Warszawie.

** **

**16 WRZEŚNIA (środa):**

Tutaj czwartek 17.09 jest rezerwą. Gdyby była zmiana na 17.09, będę pytać o dostępność smsem. Gramy parking na przejściu granicznym. Plan w Centrum Targowo-Kongresowym EXPO.

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI -  **szukam różnych aut na parking z wyłączeniem białych. Stawka **180 zł gotówką**. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

- **PODRÓŻNI / PASAŻEROWIE AUTOKARU** -  kobiety i mężczyźni w różnym wieku. Stawka **130 zł gotówką**.

 

**18 WRZEŚNIA (piątek) i 22 WRZEŚNIA (wtorek):**

Fabryka dronów, zaplecze wojenne. Plan na terenie FSO, na Jagiellońskiej.

- **MUNDUROWI I CYWILE **– kobiety i mężczyźni do 55 lat.

Stawka **130 zł gotówką – **osoby na 1 z tych dni.

Stawka  **170 zł gotówką** – **osoby kontynuacyjne na 2 dni**, wskazane przez reżysera. Łącznie **340 zł za 2 dni **płatne 22 września gotówką.

** **

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB 16** i/lub** KB 18** i**/**lub** KB 22 lub KB KONT**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

items.text:
** Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

# 21-22.09 / Trudne Sprawy

Poszukujemy dwóch profesjonalnych tancerzy, którzy mogą zagrać następujące role:

CAŁA POLSKA

Adrian Szczepański (20-24 lata) – przybrany syn głównego bohatera. Tancerz, szczupły, przystojny.

14 scen, 21 i 22.09

WOJEWÓDZTWO DOLNOŚLĄSKIE

Marek Tomczyk (20-25 lat) – stróż w magazynie Tomasza. Szczupły, tancerz.

Trzy sceny, 21.09

Płatność gotówką od razu po planie. Osoby zainteresowane proszę o wysłanie wiadomości o tytule "Trudne Sprawy IMIĘ POSTACI" wraz z:
* **aktualnymi** zdjęciami twarzy i sylwetki,
* wiekiem,
* wzrostem i wagą,
* numerem telefonu,
* materiałami video z odcinków, w których występowałeś (jeżeli grałeś w przeszłości),
* wideo wizytówką (ok. 1-minutowe nagranie, w którym przedstawiamy się, mówimy o swoim doświadczeniu aktorskim, pasjach i hobby).

na maila julia.lisowiec@polotmedia.pl

Proszę o kontakt WYŁĄCZNIE osoby dyspozycyjne w podanych terminach, w podanym przedziale wiekowym.

**CASTING CALL: LEAD ROLE**

 

We are casting the lead role of Carmelita Torres for CARMELITA, a historical short film based on true events, shooting in the Dallas/Fort Worth Area.

 

• **Union Status:** SAG-AFTRA Micro-Budget

• **Location:** Dallas–Fort Worth area

• **Rate:** $250 per shoot day, plus meals, screen credit and a digital copy of the film

• **Shoot dates:** November 7, November 11–14 and December 4–5, 2026

• **Age:** Actress, age 18–24, who can convincingly play 17. Underage actors will not be considered.
• **Language:** Must be bilingual and speak fluent Spanish with a Mexican accent
• **Travel and lodging:** provided for the actress cast as CARMELITA

 

**TO SUBMIT:**

 

Email your full name, city, phone number, headshot and résumé, if available, to:

 

[SUBMIT.MIRANDACASTING@GMAIL.COM](mailto:SUBMIT.MIRANDACASTING@GMAIL.COM)

Subject: CARMELITA – Full Name – City

 

Actors with Casting Networks or Actors Access profiles may include a link. **Please do not submit through Facebook Messenger.**

Please share with anyone who may be a good fit!

# **CASTING CALL – CHILD ACTOR | VANCOUVER, BC 🎬**

We’re currently casting the role of **Viktor** for *Hollyville*, an independent mystery/horror short film shooting in Vancouver this October.

**VIKTOR**
Boy, **5–10 years old**, all ethnicities. Viktor is a quiet, sensitive, and observant 6-year-old who has recently lost his parents. He clings closely to his older brother, Arden, as they find themselves pulled into the strange and increasingly frightening world of Hollyville.

📍 **Location:** Vancouver, BC
🎥 **Shoot Dates:** October 2–4
🎭 **Non-union / Volunteer**
🍴 Food provided on set
🎞 IMDb credit + footage provided

We’re a passionate independent filmmaking team and would love to connect with young performers interested in being part of the project.

To submit, please send a **headshot/photo, résumé, and demo reel if available** to:

📧 **info@rollthedieproductions.com**

**Submission Deadline: Sep 5, 2026**

items.text:
Hey everyone! I’m a Casting Producer for Property Brothers and casting is now OPEN for homeowners with home renovation dreams in Vancouver! 

We’re looking for:

• Homeowners who have recently purchased a home

• A minimum renovation budget of $75K

• At least 3 rooms in need of renovation

• Availability for filming beginning in early Fall 2026 & into 2027

If your new home is full of potential and you’re ready for a transformation, we’d love to hear from you.

topComments.text: “All budget tiers!” Proceeds to say the minimum is 75 thousand dollars 🤣

Do you ever feature disability specific home Reno’s? 

Homeowners can claim up to $10k in a calendar/tax year for Reno’s designed to improve accessibility and safety for people with disabilities. If the timing is just right ($10k paid in fall, $10k paid in the new year) homeowners could access $20k in tax credits, and then kick in the rest of the money for superficial / cosmetic upgrades. 

It would be really cool to see families of people with disabilities being visible on a home show & it’s possible that the Property Brothers could partner with charities all over B.C. if they wanted to donate “over and above” for a family in need who didn’t have the extra funds (due to the vast majority of primary caregivers for children with disabilities being unable to hold full time employment) 

It’s a thought. I’d definitely watch—sadly our $10k for the year is already spent.

Hallo zusammen,

für meinen Bachelor-Film „Grave Stakes“ suche ich im Raum Ebersberg bei München noch Kompars:innen für unseren Western-Dreh.

🤠 12. & 13. September 2026:
Jeweils 6 Kompars:innen pro Tag.

Western-Kleidung ist gerne gesehen, aber keine Pflicht. Ein schlichtes Hemd oder möglichst Western-like Kleidung reicht völlig aus. Westernhüte werden vor Ort zur Verfügung gestellt.

🎬 Freitag, 11. September 2026:
Hier suche ich einen Mann und eine Frau, die ein Ehepaar spielen und gemeinsam kurz durch das Bild laufen.

Bei Interesse oder Fragen meldet euch gerne direkt bei mir:

📞 0162 8235913

Drehort: Raum Ebersberg bei München

Vielen Dank!
Paul Dächert

Hallo zusammen!
Ich bin professionelle Artistin und aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen Engagements und Castings in Deutschland und Europa.

Meine Schwerpunkte sind Seiltanz / Balance-Acts, Bühne, Show und Performance. Ich bin Guinness World Record Holder und habe internationale Bühnenerfahrung, u. a. bei Britain’s Got Talent, TV-Produktionen, Varieté, Zirkus und internationalen Shows.

Ich freue mich über Kontakte zu Agenturen, Produzenten, Veranstaltern und Casting Directors sowie über Hinweise auf aktuelle Castings und Engagements.

Wohnort: Bayern | deutschlandweit & international verfügbar.
Portfolio, Videos und weitere Informationen sende ich gerne per PN.

Vielen Dank!
Oksana Seroshtan

🎬 EXTRAS CASTING CALL -THEATRE AUDIENCE SHORT FILM - 8th SEPTEMBER
We’re looking for male & female extras for a variety of scenes in an upcoming short film TONOS.

Written by BAFTA-winning Aleksandra Sykulak, TONOS is a psychological drama about finding your voice when you’ve spent your life being spoken for. The film will be shot on 16mm, with Julio Peña (El Cautivo, BERLIN, Through My Window) attached to star opposite Coro, who will also lead the cast.

Link to apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdhDsA9Hp6453DgtaFQf2FihlbQDH_eJZITqCsPuK5xdNv-uw/viewform

👥 EXTRAS WANTED:

• Men & women, 

• Variety of ages and looks

• No acting experience required

• Comfortable taking direction and appearing on camera

🎥 Extras will be needed to participate as the theatre audience 

🗣️ No speaking required — these are primarily non-speaking background roles.

📍 London — South East London

📅  filming date — 8th September 

💰 UNPAID / volunteer production

If interested, DM me with your name, age, and a recent photo.

Help us bring this beautiful film to life.

CHAPMAN UNIVERSITY THESIS FILM CASTING CALL

PARENTS SUBSTITUTE — Comedy/Drama

Logline: After getting into serious trouble at school, an international high schooler hires two strangers to pose as his parents for a disciplinary meeting, only for the lie to become increasingly difficult to control.

Shoot Dates: Oct. 2–4 & Oct. 9–11, 2026

Location: Orange County / Chapman University area

Auditions: Self-tape, callbacks if needed

NON-UNION ONLY. SAG-AFTRA / union performers cannot be considered.

JUSTIN — Lead, Male, 18, East Asian. Rebellious and emotionally guarded, Justin uses sarcasm and makes impulsive decisions to avoid facing the consequences of his actions. Beneath his detached attitude lies a deep fear of disappointing his family and of being forced to admit he is struggling. Seeking strong deadpan comedic timing and subtle dramatic range. Pay: $150/day, est. 6 days / $900 total.

PRINCIPAL ANDERSON — Supporting, Male, 40-60, any ethnicity. A stern and intimidating school administrator with very dry humor. Seeking strong authority and understated comedic timing. Pay: $150/day, est. 4 days / $600 total.

MIA — Supporting, Female, 40s, any ethnicity. Glamorous, confident, unpredictable stranger hired to pose as Justin’s mother. Strong comedic timing and expressive screen presence. Pay: $150/day, est. 3 days / $450 total.

TOM — Supporting, Male, 40s, any ethnicity. Rough, awkward Uber driver hired to pose as Justin’s father. Seeking natural deadpan comedy with warmth underneath. Pay: $150/day, est. 3 days / $450 total.

RYAN — Supporting, Male, 20s, any ethnicity. Justin’s social, easygoing, casually chaotic roommate and friend. Natural comedic timing and relaxed charisma. Unpaid; meals, copy, and credit provided.

AI NOTICE: This production will use AI-generated and/or AI-assisted visual elements during post-production/VFX. Additional details will be provided to selected performers before signing.

TO SUBMIT: Email zmao@chapman.edu with subject “PARENTS SUBSTITUTE — [ROLE] — [NAME]” and include headshot, résumé, reel if available, current location, availability for the shoot dates, and confirmation that you are non-union.

items.text:
Zwei unglaubliche Konzerte 🎶von TRAIN45, die es in sich hatten; nicht zuletzt auch und gerade wegen des begeisterten Leeraner Publikums. Auch sie vollführten so manchen „summer jump“! 
Wir Musiker 🪕🎙️🎻🎸sind noch total 💯 geflasht, hin und weg 🤩 und heel over‘t stüür!!!
Auch Jolina Carl, die ja Ende Nov. hier im Kulturspeicher Leer gemeinsam mit Sievert Ahrend mit deren neu gegründetem Duo Mr. JoSie ihre Live- Premiere bei Mr.JoSie‘s Country Christmas geben wird, war mehr als beeindruckt! Schön, dass du dich persönlich vorgestellt hast, Jolina! ♥️
Vielen herzlichen Dank 🙏🏽 für so viel Hilfe und Unterstützung an all die lieben Menschen von: Hibben (Vorverkauf), Presse 🗞️, Kulturspeicher bzw. Stadtbibliothek Leer, Maike (50er Wohnzimmer), Michaela vom Genussreich (Bewirtung) und an Anja 😘für die ganze Organisation. An Frank Ammermann von der Rheiderland Zeitung 📰 für die superschönen Photos (Bericht folgt): Toll, dass du dir die Zeit genommen hast, Frank! 
Unser besonderer Dank geht diesmal an die Leeraner Feuerwehrleute 👩‍🚒, die schon vorher lange bei einem Großbrand 🔥 im Einsatz waren! Enorm, was ihr leistet!!!
Und last but not least an unser tolles Leeraner Publikum: Ihr seid Spitzenklasse!!! 👏🏼 🙌 

#summerjump #train45 #kulturspeicherleer #50erjahremusik #countrymusic rockabilly

Zwei unglaubliche Konzerte 🎶von TRAIN45, die es in sich hatten; nicht zuletzt auch und gerade wegen des begeisterten Leeraner Publikums. Auch sie vollführten so manchen „summer jump“! 
Wir Musiker 🪕🎙️🎻🎸sind noch total 💯 geflasht, hin und weg 🤩 und heel over‘t stüür!!!
Auch Jolina Carl, die ja Ende Nov. hier im Kulturspeicher Leer gemeinsam mit Sievert Ahrend mit deren neu gegründetem Duo Mr. JoSie ihre Live- Premiere bei Mr.JoSie‘s Country Christmas geben wird, war mehr als beeindruckt! Schön, dass du dich persönlich vorgestellt hast, Jolina! ♥️
Vielen herzlichen Dank 🙏🏽 für so viel Hilfe und Unterstützung an all die lieben Menschen von: Hibben (Vorverkauf), Presse 🗞️, Kulturspeicher bzw. Stadtbibliothek Leer, Maike (50er Wohnzimmer), Michaela vom Genussreich (Bewirtung) und an Anja 😘für die ganze Organisation. An Frank Ammermann von der Rheiderland Zeitung 📰 für die superschönen Photos (Bericht folgt): Toll, dass du dir die Zeit genommen hast, Frank! 
Unser besonderer Dank geht diesmal an die Leeraner Feuerwehrleute 👩‍🚒, die schon vorher lange bei einem Großbrand 🔥 im Einsatz waren! Enorm, was ihr leistet!!!
Und last but not least an unser tolles Leeraner Publikum: Ihr seid Spitzenklasse!!! 👏🏼 🙌 

#summerjump #train45 #kulturspeicherleer #50erjahremusik #countrymusic rockabilly

Hi everyone! 

I'm currently casting for my short which I hope to submit to Shits N Giggles. The aim is to film September 19th and 20th.

**Title **

Global Warming, Am I Right?

**Logline **

A police detective tries to solve a case related to a classic holiday song.

**Cast**

POLICE DETECTIVE (40s) - Male. Any ethnicity. Takes life quite seriously except when he's talking to the love of his life: Petey.

POLICE OFFICER (late-20s - 30s) - Male. Any ethnicity. Clean-shaven and quite eager to help the detective in any way possible.

JANE (40s) - Female. Any ethnicity. The police detective's wife who is frustrated by the lack of attention he gives her compared to the attention he gives Petey. Must be comfortable covered in fake blood... and feathers.

**Compensation**

Volunteer. Food and IMDb credit.

**Location**

Vancouver West Side and UBC

**Contact**

If you have any questions, please feel free to message or email me with your headshot, resumé, and demo reel if you have one. My email is adamscamvougeras@gmail.com. 

Take care and I hope everyone's had a great long weekend!

**CASTING CALL – PAID, NON-UNION COMMERCIAL**

Novel Productions is casting **two roles** for a 1**5-second commercial** for Applewood Auto Group.

**Shoot Location:** Langley, BC

**Shoot Date:** September 18th + 20th, 2026 (1-2 days, 4-8 hours per day, depending on role)

**Compensation:** $1000 (Including buyout)

**ROLES:**

• **Driver** — Age **25–55** | Male, ethnicity open (Needed September 18th + 20th)

• **Weatherman** — Age **35–55** | Male, ethnicity open (Needed only September 18th). Looking specifically for a *Ron Burgundy*-type portrayal.

**SUBMISSIONS:**

Please send **headshot, acting resume, and reel (if available)** to: **casting@novelproductions.ca**

**Subject line:**

*Applewood Casting - Role Name - Your Name*

12-month usage term. Additional details will be provided to selected talent.

Selected submissions will be contacted with sides and instructions for self-tape auditions.

We encourage submissions from actors of all backgrounds.

topComments.text: No judgement, just information: typical buyouts for non-union commercials for one year range from 4000$ - 8000$+ Applewood is a large company, likely fully capable of paying going rates without taking advantage of struggling actors.

What Scott McQuarrie said. Plus this is an auto related ad, and there are a number of auto ads made every year in the Vancouver area that pay much better than this. But once you are in an ad, then you are ineligible to appear in an ad for a competing or similar project for a minimum of two years and in some cases clients do not want people who have been in a similar product ad to appear in theirs for up to 5 years. So anyone who appears in this ad had better be prepared to not do anything related to the auto industry for up to 5 years.

Reels-Darsteller/in für Food & Social Media Content gesucht | Nebenjob / Freelance | Wien

Wir suchen Verstärkung für unser Content-Team! 
Für regelmäßige Social-Media-Produktionen im Bereich Food, Restaurants & Gastronomie suchen wir eine sympathische, zuverlässige und kamerafreudige Person, die unser Team ca. 1 Tag pro Woche unterstützt.

Deine Aufgaben:
🎥 Mitwirkung als Haupt- oder Nebenrolle in Reels & Social-Media-Videos
🎭 Natürliches und authentisches Auftreten vor der Kamera
🎬 Bei Bedarf Kamera/Smartphone bedienen und andere Personen filmen
🎥 Idealerweise auch Unterstützung bei Regie, Kamerawinkeln und Ablauf der Aufnahmen
💡 Eigene Ideen und kreativer Input sind sehr willkommen

Das solltest du mitbringen:
Sympathisches, natürliches gepflegtes und positives Auftreten
Keine Scheu vor Kamera oder vorgegebenen Scripts
Sicherer Umgang mit Smartphone & moderner Technik
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen
Zuverlässigkeit und Flexibilität
Erfahrung mit Kamera, Social Media, Reels oder Content Creation ist ein großer Vorteil
Erfahrung als Darsteller/in oder mit Regie/Kamera ebenfalls von Vorteil

Was wir bieten:
Stundenlohn – Höhe wird je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation persönlich vereinbart
Essen während der Produktion
Unbegrenzte Getränke während der Produktion
Regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit / ca. 1 Tag pro Woche
Mitarbeit an unterschiedlichen kreativen Projekten im Bereich Food & Social Media
Ein lockeres, kreatives Arbeitsumfeld

📍 Einsatzort: Wien & Umgebung
Umfang: ca. 1 Tag pro Woche / nach vorheriger Terminvereinbarung

Interesse?
Dann schick mir gerne eine kurze Vorstellung + Foto und, falls vorhanden, Instagram/TikTok-Profil oder Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeit per 
PN oder mail: cemkusneci@gmail.com

Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

‼️ WARSAW, SEPTEMBER 10‼️
For a big, international film project, we are looking for:

▪️ AFROAMERICANS aged approximately 20-80. Rate depending on hours and role: 250-400 PLN, cash, paid after the shoot. Especially people who like to dance!!

Colorful hair, afro, dreadlocks, tattoos, piercings, beards, etc. are welcome.

▪️ FOR EPISODIC ROLES: a WOMAN with piercings and a wild hairstyle, and a MAN with a tattooed face. Rate depending on hours: 700-1000 PLN, paid after the shoot.

▪️ FOR EPISODIC ROLES: MAN or WOMAN of Mexican heritage as a waiter. Rate depending on hours: 700-1000 PLN, paid after the shoot.

This will be a day-into-night shoot near Szwedzka metro station.

Please send your application — including your first and last name, phone number and CURRENT photos to: KAROLINA@ONSETAGENCY.PL with “TPB” in the subject line.

Hey Ottawa Filmmakers! 

I’m looking for a few crew members to volunteer for my short film project (if enough funds are raised each volunteer will receive an honorarium 🤞🏼) and food, credit and gas reimbursment will definitely be provided - if available and interested, please email your materials to: claudiajurtpictures@gmail.com

PS as this is a small production, some of the crew positions may be doubled up 

Film: THE PB & J CONUNDRUM
Director: Claudia Jurt
Cinematographer: Geghani Panosian
Cast: Joshua Odjick (The Long Walk, IT: Welcome to Derry, Wildhood, Bon Cop, Bad Cop series, Little Bird, etc) & Joy Ruano

Date: Sunday, September 13, 2026
Location: Casselman, ON
Time: 8:00am-7:00pm (tentative)

Crew Members Needed:

Production Assistant 

Key Hair/Make-up - for an Indigenous male (20’s) and a 6.5 year old Indigenous girl (no make up for her, hair only - both have long hair 

Key Wardrobe 

Drone Operator - must come with camera to shoot overhead of farm property when yellow school bus arrives

Craft Services 

Stills Photographer

Props 

Art Director/Set Deck - one of the key things here are peanut butter and jelly jars with created labels 

1st Assistant Director 

Sound Recordist 

Our shooting location is approximately 40-60min east of Ottawa depending on which part of town you’re coming from - we also may have transportation available for a few people 

Thank you and look forward to hearing from you!

Best wishes,
Claudia

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL – FEMALE LEAD ROLE | SHORT FILM

I’m looking to cast the lead role of Emily in my upcoming short film Good Grief, which I’ve written and am directing.

This is my first short film project, and it’s a passion project that I’m putting a lot of time, care and attention into. The rest of the cast is already in place, the locations and props are sorted, and we’re now just looking for the right actress to bring Emily to life.

🎭 ROLE: EMILY

Female | Mid-20s (22 to 26) White/Caucasian 

Emily is sensitive, warm, introspective and deeply emotional. This is a lead role and the character carries much of the film, so I’m looking for someone who can really nail the emotional scenes and bring a genuine, natural performance rather than simply delivering lines.

There are some particularly emotional moments in the film, so emotional range and the ability to convey grief, love and vulnerability naturally are really important.

🎥 THE FILM

Good Grief is an intimate, cinematic short film exploring love, grief, memory and the softness we carry after losing someone we love.

The film is being made with film festival submissions in mind, and I’m passionate about creating something visually beautiful and emotionally meaningful.

📍 Location: Haworth, West Yorkshire
📅 Filming: September 2026 — exact date to be confirmed
⏱️ Duration: Approx. 10–15 minutes
💷 Payment: Unpaid — this is my first independent short film and is being made as a passion project. All production elements, props and the rest of the cast are already organised.

I completely appreciate that unpaid work isn’t for everyone, but if you’re an actress who is passionate about acting and would love to be part of a small, ambitious short film, I’d love to hear from you. If however there is an actor who has a lot of experience already I could try to find a way to pay a fee. 

📩 TO APPLY

Please DM me with:

• Headshot
• Showreel / previous acting work (if available)
• Spotlight link (if applicable)
• Location
• Availability in September

I’ll send Emily’s dialogue / casting tape material to anyone interested in auditioning.

Please feel free to share or tag any actresses who you think could be right for the role.

Thank you! 🎬

**Title: ACTS OF MERCY**

**Genre: ***Drama*

**Logline: **Following the death of her mother, a veterinarian faces addiction and guilt as she tries to evade grief.

**Roles:**

**MAGNOLIA **- *LEAD - Female, 20-35*

Magnolia is no stranger to death, running an in-home animal hospital, yet refuses to grieve the death of her mother. She faces guilt, addiction, and drug induced hallucinations, but continually tries to bury her feelings.

**MARIE **- *SUPPORTING - Female, 40-60*

Marie is eccentric, confident in her decisions, and unafraid to grieve. She knows that euthanizing her cat will prevent it from suffering longer, but that doesn't lessen the impact of loss. She feels no embarrassment when expressing her grief.

**Director**: Evangeline Buchenberger

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**:

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 10am-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "ACTS OF MERCY CASTING - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will send you sides to send in as a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 14th, 16-19th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to drug use, self harm, and euthanasia.

CASTING CALL:
Title: Sugarwater
Genre: Sci-fi/horror, student short film
Logline: Two construction workers uncover a strange creature in the dirt.

Characters:

Cam (M, 20s-30s, LEAD): 
An enamored construction worker with his head in the clouds.

Riley (M, 20s-30s, LEAD):
A sensible worker just trying to get through the day.

TV Woman (F, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
An old-Hollywood starlet radiating glamor.

TV Man (M, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
A classic noir antihero with a tendency to break hearts.

Shooting will take place over 4 days in November for Cam and Riley, and one day in October for the TV Woman and TV Man, all in or around the Denver, CO area. Compensation will be meals, gas compensation, credit, and a copy of the final film. The final film will be exhibited at CU Denver's Cinefest in May 2027 and will then be submitted to other film festivals for further distribution.

Use this link or scan the QR code in the flyer below to access to audition form: https://forms.gle/v9PMj5nAh4wV7fpA8

If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at caitlin.lebakken@cuanschutz.edu. Thank you!

**16 / 18 / 22 września**

**Serial fabularny KB**

** **

Na plan serialu fabularnego KB szukam statystów na dni poniżej. Tym razem przenosimy się na przejście graniczne z Ukrainą. Magia kina – gramy w Warszawie.

** **

**16 WRZEŚNIA (środa):**

Tutaj czwartek 17.09 jest rezerwą. Gdyby była zmiana na 17.09, będę pytać o dostępność smsem. Gramy parking na przejściu granicznym. Plan w Centrum Targowo-Kongresowym EXPO.

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI -  **szukam różnych aut na parking z wyłączeniem białych. Stawka **180 zł gotówką**. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

- **PODRÓŻNI / PASAŻEROWIE AUTOKARU** -  kobiety i mężczyźni w różnym wieku. Stawka **130 zł gotówką**.

 

**18 WRZEŚNIA (piątek) i 22 WRZEŚNIA (wtorek):**

Fabryka dronów, zaplecze wojenne. Plan na terenie FSO, na Jagiellońskiej.

- **MUNDUROWI I CYWILE **– kobiety i mężczyźni do 55 lat.

Stawka **130 zł gotówką – **osoby na 1 z tych dni.

Stawka  **170 zł gotówką** – **osoby kontynuacyjne na 2 dni**, wskazane przez reżysera. Łącznie **340 zł za 2 dni **płatne 22 września gotówką.

** **

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB 16** i/lub** KB 18** i**/**lub** KB 22 lub KB KONT**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

AKTOR/SZUKAM PROJEKTÓW
Hej! Mam na imię Dominik Kusajda, mam 18 lat i szukam możliwości udziału w filmach, serialach, reklamach, teledyskach oraz innych produkcjach.

🎭 Od października rozpoczynam naukę w studium aktorskim i intensywnie rozwijam się w kierunku aktorstwa. Mam doświadczenie przed kamerą, m.in.:

• „Uroczysko” – epizod

• „Policjanci i Policjantki” – epizod

• „Trudne Sprawy” – rola drugoplanowa

• „Sprawiedliwi – Trójmiasto”

Przez 4 lata aktywnie interesowałem się również modelingiem i brałem udział m.in. w „Top Model”.

Dodatkowo umiem strzelać z łuku, co może być przydatną umiejętnością przy odpowiednich rolach i produkcjach.

Jestem otwarty na różnego rodzaju role i produkcje. Zależy mi przede wszystkim na zdobywaniu doświadczenia, pracy na planie i rozwijaniu się jako aktor

AKTOR/SZUKAM PROJEKTÓW
Hej! Mam na imię Dominik Kusajda, mam 18 lat i szukam możliwości udziału w filmach, serialach, reklamach, teledyskach oraz innych produkcjach.

🎭 Od października rozpoczynam naukę w studium aktorskim i intensywnie rozwijam się w kierunku aktorstwa. Mam doświadczenie przed kamerą, m.in.:

• „Uroczysko” – epizod

• „Policjanci i Policjantki” – epizod

• „Trudne Sprawy” – rola drugoplanowa

• „Sprawiedliwi – Trójmiasto”

Przez 4 lata aktywnie interesowałem się również modelingiem i brałem udział m.in. w „Top Model”.

Dodatkowo umiem strzelać z łuku, co może być przydatną umiejętnością przy odpowiednich rolach i produkcjach.

Jestem otwarty na różnego rodzaju role i produkcje. Zależy mi przede wszystkim na zdobywaniu doświadczenia, pracy na planie i rozwijaniu się jako aktor

items.text:
I’m trying to help cast teens (ages 12–17) for a b-roll shoot for Edgeline Films' upcoming documentary, The Anxious Generation, exploring how phones and social media have changed childhood and adolescence. The film will premiere on a streamer next year! 

The Details: 

Filming: Sunday, Sept 13th, 10am–6pm in south slope, Brooklyn. We only need a one or two hour window — happy to work around your teen's schedule.

What we're shooting: Stylized, cinematic shots of teens on phones -- scrolling through social media, macro shots of eyes as they scroll, hands swiping, and other candid glimpses of everyday life growing up with smartphones. 

No acting or speaking experience needed — just teens who are open to being on camera (and hanging out on a fun set!). 

If you know anyone who might be open to participating, please have them fill out this form 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf-KU_Mw_Ca8I4EHJzzh9NnEHxOb2lKP-SfIbkUdWrBR6uqTA/viewform

and our producer Sophie will reach out

topComments.text: I have 7 years old. If u ever need someone in DC around that age let me know. Thank you.

Hey, ich bin Kerem, 18 Jahre alt und angehender Schauspieler aus dem Ruhrgebiet. Ich bin aktuell auf der Suche nach Regisseuren und Filmschaffenden in NRW, mit denen ich spannende Kurzfilmprojekte realisieren kann.

Ich habe bereits in drei Kurzfilmen mitgespielt und bin immer auf der Suche nach neuen Möglichkeiten, vor der Kamera zu arbeiten und gemeinsam kreative Projekte umzusetzen.

Ich habe außerdem etwas zu Kurzfilmfestivals recherchiert und bin dabei auf die Internationalen Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen und das KFFK „Battle of the Shorts“ gestoßen:

https://www.kurzfilmtage.de/de/festival/einreichung/

https://www.kffk.de/battle-of-the-shorts/

Vielleicht hast du ja selbst schon länger eine Idee für einen Kurzfilm oder hättest Lust, gemeinsam etwas auf die Beine zu stellen. Gerade ein Projekt mit dem Ziel, es anschließend bei passenden Festivals einzureichen, fände ich sehr spannend.

Falls du grundsätzlich Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit hast, würde ich mich sehr über einen Austausch freuen! 🙌

LG
Kerem

Filmmakers: https://www.filmmakers.eu/de/actors/kerem-dag
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/keremdg_?igsi=OWgxdTdkZWs2b3J6&utm_source=qr

✨ NOUVEAUTÉ DE LA RENTRÉE : DES COURS POUR LES ENFANTS ! ✨
Cette saison, Ty Cabaret ouvre de nouveaux cours spécialement pensés pour les enfants et les jeunes 💃🎶

🧒 Danse & Expression
Et petite nouveauté ! Suite aux nombreuses demandes reçues, nous avons décidé d'élargir le cours : il sera désormais accessible dès 3 ans ✨
Un cours pour découvrir la danse, bouger, s'exprimer, développer sa créativité et prendre confiance… tout en s'amusant !

🔥 Afropop
Un cours dynamique et actuel, sur des musiques modernes, pour apprendre des chorégraphies pleines d'énergie !

💰 Seulement 170 € à l'année pour 1h de cours par semaine
✨ Cours d'essai gratuit pour venir découvrir avant de s'inscrire !

📅 Rentrée des cours à partir du lundi 14 septembre
Nous sommes très heureux de proposer ces nouveautés cette année et d'ouvrir encore un peu plus les portes de Ty Cabaret aux plus jeunes ❤️

📩 Inscriptions et renseignements par message privé
Et un grand merci au journal pour ce joli article consacré à cette nouveauté ! 📰✨

items.text:
Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

items.text:
Hi everyone! 😊 I’m looking to get back into acting and would love the opportunity to gain some on-screen experience.

I have a Diploma in Drama & Dance and I’m open to anything from extras work and small roles to TV, film, commercials or larger productions. I’m happy to start wherever I can and build my experience from there.

I don’t currently have a professional self-tape/showreel, but I’d absolutely love the opportunity to put one together and show what I can do.

If anyone knows of any casting opportunities, productions looking for extras/cast, or upcoming projects that I could get involved with, I’d really appreciate a message. 🙏🏽

I’m based in West Yorkshire but happy to travel for the right opportunity.

Thank you! ❤️🎭

WANTED !!!!!
I am Thomas Goersch from Stuttgart, Germany. 
Actor and Filmdirector. 
I am a director of Independent Movies.
I present my movies on International Film festivals and was lucky to receive some awards. 
But the work is not about awards and money, its about making movies for the people to think about.
My next movie is a modern love story:
An elderly man is meeting another younger, very attractive man in the Internet. But they are from different Continents. They start a long distance relastionship ship. which is full of passion and desire. 
One day the younger man starts to ask for money, cause he is a Student and no more able to pay his bills. 
The older man is full of distrust.
Is he only there to pay his lovers bills or is there love between them ?
A story with two endings.
One with true love and one with only cheating. Based on a real story.
I am looking for the young attraktive Lover.
Men 25 to 36 years old, good looking who is able to film his parts on his own by smartshone
I am always open and honest. You can earn no money on this. but maybe there is a good film in the end promoting for you.
Thats me

please ask for details.

**🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

THRILLER-MUSICAL: AUDITION I WEEKENDEN!
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt dansere af alle køn!

Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

🎬 CASTING CALL - FEATURE FILM
THE EIGHT SAGA: N.E.S.T PROJECT
We are casting MORRIGAN - Head of Science (30s-50s), a fantastic, complex role for an actress looking for something they can really get their teeth into.
Intelligent, sophisticated and unnervingly calm, Morrigan’s faith in science and progress develops into an obsession with control. We’re looking for a strong actress who can bring authority, intelligence and subtle menace to the role.
This is an unpaid passion project, with IMDb credit intended and festival ambitions including Cannes submission. It’s a substantial dramatic role and an opportunity to become part of a growing creative team and potential future projects.
TO APPLY:
Please send your headshot, Spotlight link and/or showreel, acting CV and current location to:

THE EIGHT SAGA: N.E.S.T PROJECT
We are casting MORRIGAN - Head of Science (30s-50s), a fantastic, complex role for an actress looking for something they can really get their teeth into.
Intelligent, sophisticated and unnervingly calm, Morrigan’s faith in science and progress develops into an obsession with control. We’re looking for a strong actress who can bring authority, intelligence and subtle menace to the role.
This is an unpaid passion project, with IMDb credit intended and festival ambitions including Cannes submission. It’s a substantial dramatic role and an opportunity to become part of a growing creative team and potential future projects.

Du redest gerne und dein Deutsch ist flüssig? Dann bewirb dich fürs Casting!

Zu dritt führt ihr ein lockeres, improvisiertes Gespräch zu einem Thema (6–8 Minuten) und macht danach ein paar kurze Übungen mit Text. Insgesamt dauert das Ganze nur 15–20 Minuten – in zentraler Lage in Berlin.

📅 Termin: Mittwoch, 9. September

💰 20€ für deine Teilnahme – unabhängig vom Ergebnis!

🎓 Nichts vorzubereiten, nichts auswendig zu lernen – einfach so sprechen wie immer

Wirst du ausgewählt, geht's weiter mit wöchentlichen Aufnahme-Sessions (60€ brutto/Std., 4–8 Std.) auf Vertragsbasis als selbstständige:r Auftragnehmer:in, Auszahlung über die Plattform Dots.

Die Aufnahmen werden für Sprach-KI & virtuelle Assistenten genutzt – kein Stimmklon.

✅ Formular ausfüllen dauert nur 3–4 Minuten. Genaue Uhrzeit & Adresse werden telefonisch mit dir bestätigt.

⚠️ Es wird nie Geld von dir verlangt, niemand fragt vorab nach Bankdaten, Ausweis oder Adresse.

Interesse? Jetzt bewerben: https://forms.gle/9cQ1ifMewXTBwVCK8

CASTING CALL:
Title: The Art of Making Mistakes

Genre: Drama, Comedy, Student film. 

Logline: The Art of Making Mistakes is a dark comedy that centers on an over productive father, who’s worked hard to provide for his family, and his son, who’s faced the consequences of his absence.

CHARACTERS:

Larry (Early 30s, Hispanic): A machismo father who has spent his whole life building a home for his wife and son, only to realize he’s never actually had time to live in it. Brash. Stuck in his ways.

Xavier (8–12, Hispanic): A young boy forced to write his school report on his macho, enigmatic father. Curious and stubborn. Questions others as much as he questions himself. Where he goes, trouble follows.

Tom (Any race, 40s-50s): A machismo boss at a construction company. Distances himself from co-workers to avoid attachment. Utterly professional. A straight shooter.

Maria (Early 30s, Hispanic): An old-school Hispanic mother. Fiercely protective. The only thread keeping her family intact. Understands that forgiveness and discipline are a balancing act.

Shooting will take place within late October and early November. Filming for 4 to 5 days on the Westminster, CO and Denver, CO area. 

We will provide a meal every day; there will also be snacks and drinks. Once post-production is complete, those involved in the project will be given access to the short film. 

Self-tapes will be available; keep an eye out for the next post!

Email david.renteria@ucdenver.edu for more information.
